MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Pond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
